sections.Profile:
Amigo is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in May 1974. This was the first pinball game designed by Greg Kmiec, who later became well-known for designing several popular pinball machines such as Xenon and Captain Fantastic . The machine has a Mexican theme, featuring artwork by Dick White that includes vibrant imagery of a Mexican bandito and a donkey on the backglass.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
